title: Subadditive bijections on the positive reals
summary: We show that there exists a subadditive bijection $f:(0,\infty)\to(0,\infty)$ such that $\liminf_{x\to 0}f(x)=0$ and $\limsup_{x\to 0}f(x)=1$. This answers a question by Matkowski and Swiatkowski in [Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. 119 (1993), 187--197].
